tasks.name: VFX List and Budget
tasks.objective: Produce the VFX List and Budget for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every gameplay event mapped to an effect with priority
Particle and overdraw budgets stated per effect class
Cue timing in milliseconds aligned to animation cancel windows

tasks.name: VFX Set
tasks.objective: Produce the VFX Set for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every listed effect exists, triggers on its event and cleans up
Effects pooled and capped to the stated particle budget
Effect LOD present for the lowest quality tier

tasks.name: VFX Budget Review
tasks.objective: Produce the VFX Budget Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Worst-case simultaneous effects measured and within budget
Overdraw hotspots identified with a fix
Effects verified at the lowest quality tier
